say:1:1320903001:0.text: Excuse me, ma'am, are you looking for someone?
say:1:1320903001:0.source_cn: 这位女士，你是在找人吗？

say:2:1320903002:0.text: Yes, I'm looking for my son, Naum. He's eight years old. Have you seen him, by any chance?

choice_prompt:3:1320903002.text: Yes, I'm looking for my son, Naum. He's eight years old. Have you seen him, by any chance?
choice_prompt:3:1320903002.source_cn: 对，我在找我儿子，他叫瑙姆，看起来八九岁的样子。你们有见到他吗？

say:4:1320903003:0.text: Oh no, what should I do...

say:6:1320903004:0.text: Please don't panic! Do you have any idea where he could have gone?
say:6:1320903004:0.source_cn: 别着急，你知道你儿子去哪里了吗？

say:7:1320903006:1.text: Naum has always been fascinated by stories about the undead. During the day, he likes to sneak off to the cemetery to go on his little "adventures." He did the same today.
say:7:1320903006:1.source_cn: 瑙姆从小就对活死人的故事很感兴趣，经常趁着白天跑到墓园...

say:8:1320903007:0.text: But it's been longer than usual... I already checked the cemetery, but there's no sign of him... And now it's almost dark!

say:9:1320903008:0.text: Have you heard the saying? "One must never venture into the wild after dark", or you'll run into terrible dangers! I... I have to find Naum quickly!
say:9:1320903008:0.source_cn: 你们听说过那句准则吗？“不要进入野外的夜晚”，否则就会...

say:14:1320903013:1.text: But the cemetery is dangerous at night! I can't let you risk yourselves like that...
say:14:1320903013:1.source_cn: 可是……晚上的墓园很危险！我不能让你们去冒险……

say:15:1320903014:0.text: It's fine! Our friend here is a powerful mage, nothing will happen to us.
say:15:1320903014:0.source_cn: 不用顾虑这一点！我们的主人是很厉害的魔法师，绝对不会出事的！
say:15:1320903014:0.male: It's fine! Our friend here is a powerful mage, nothing will happen to us.
say:15:1320903014:0.female: It's fine! Our friend here is a powerful mage, nothing will happen to us.

say:16:1320903015:1.text: Exactly! You should head home, we'll bring your son back to you!
say:16:1320903015:1.source_cn: 是呀，你还是早点回去吧，别让家里人更担心。

say:17:1320903016:0.text: Well... alright. Thank you so much! Please, find my son!
say:17:1320903016:0.source_cn: 那……那我只能先谢谢你们了！请一定要找到瑙姆啊！

choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 我们再去墓园里看看吧

say:19:1320903010:1.text: I'm certain. He told me before he left.
say:19:1320903010:1.source_cn: 肯定就在那附近，他出门前亲口和我说的。

say:19:1320903010:1.female: I'm certain. He told me before he left.

say:20:1320903011:0.text: Then we'll take another look! Maybe he just didn't notice you were looking for him earlier.
say:20:1320903011:0.source_cn: 那我们就再过去看看吧！说不定瑙姆刚才只是没注意到你去找他了。
